current.text: Washington has a crowded group of young wings and guards, and Riley is one of them.
Washington added Anthony Davis, Trae Young and AJ Dybantsa. Notes say this cuts into the roles of the team's young players.
Riley is not in the projected starting five of Trae Young, Kyshawn George, AJ Dybantsa, Anthony Davis and Alex Sarr.
The fifth starter spot is unclear, and many wings are competing for it.
Ben expects a 10 or 11 man rotation, with 12 or 13 players who could justify minutes.
Washington is trying to compete and push for the play-in. It is no longer rebuilding.
He averaged 22.5 points in two Summer League games and shot well.
The expert does not expect his late-season fantasy value to return, because Washington has too many wings and guards.

durable.text: Steals are a clear weakness. His projected steals are far below the top 250 pool.
